laterChanges: Georgia enacted a 2026 Property Tax Relief Grant providing an $18,000 assessed-value reduction to qualifying homesteads; it is not a 2025 credit.
name: Georgia
overview: Georgia combines statewide minimum homestead exemptions with locally adopted exemptions.

programs.name: State-law homestead exemptions
programs.ageRule: General homeowner exemption, with additional age-based options.
programs.incomeDefinition: Senior exemptions use specially defined prior-year income; some retirement income excluded.
programs.incomeLimits: The age-65 county exemption uses a $10,000 claimant/spouse income limit.
programs.maximumBenefit: General $2,000 assessed-value exemption; additional senior and local exemptions differ.
programs.formulaSummary: Reduces taxable assessed value for specified county/school levies.
programs.application: Apply through county tax officials by applicable homestead deadline.
eligibilityNotes: Local exemptions may be more generous than the state-law minimum.

researchNotes: The listed 2025 program covers homestead exemptions. Periodic homeowner grants use their own tax years.
